heading.en: Where to take it, where to put it

hook.en: Feedback can sample the output voltage or the output current, and can be mixed at the input in series or in shunt. The choice decides the input and output impedance.
hook.kn: ಪ್ರತಿಪೋಷಣೆ ಔಟ್‌ಪುಟ್ ವೋಲ್ಟೇಜ್ ಅಥವಾ ಪ್ರವಾಹವನ್ನು ಮಾದರಿ ತೆಗೆಯಬಹುದು, ಮತ್ತು ಇನ್‌ಪುಟ್‌ನಲ್ಲಿ ಸರಣಿ ಅಥವಾ ಸಮಾಂತರವಾಗಿ ಸೇರಿಸಬಹುದು. ಈ ಆಯ್ಕೆ ಇನ್‌ಪುಟ್ ಮತ್ತು ಔಟ್‌ಪುಟ್ ಪ್ರತಿರೋಧವನ್ನು ನಿರ್ಧರಿಸುತ್ತದೆ.

objectives.en: Name the four types of negative feedback
State the effect of each on input and output impedance
Identify the type in a given circuit

narration.en: Feedback can sample the output voltage or the output current, and can be mixed at the input in series or in shunt. The choice decides the input and output impedance.
narration.kn: ಪ್ರತಿಪೋಷಣೆ ಔಟ್‌ಪುಟ್ ವೋಲ್ಟೇಜ್ ಅಥವಾ ಪ್ರವಾಹವನ್ನು ಮಾದರಿ ತೆಗೆಯಬಹುದು, ಮತ್ತು ಇನ್‌ಪುಟ್‌ನಲ್ಲಿ ಸರಣಿ ಅಥವಾ ಸಮಾಂತರವಾಗಿ ಸೇರಿಸಬಹುದು. ಈ ಆಯ್ಕೆ ಇನ್‌ಪುಟ್ ಮತ್ತು ಔಟ್‌ಪುಟ್ ಪ್ರತಿರೋಧವನ್ನು ನಿರ್ಧರಿಸುತ್ತದೆ.

body.en: A topology is named by what is sampled at the output and how the feedback is mixed at the input. Voltage sampling: the feedback network is in parallel with the load. Current sampling: it is in series with the load. Series mixing: the feedback voltage is in series with the source. Shunt mixing: the feedback current is in parallel with the input. This gives voltage-series, voltage-shunt, current-series and current-shunt feedback. Examples: an emitter follower is voltage-series; a CE stage with unbypassed $R_E$ is current-series; a collector-to-base resistor gives voltage-shunt feedback.

narration.en: There are four types: voltage-series, voltage-shunt, current-series and current-shunt, named by output sampling and input mixing.
narration.kn: ನಾಲ್ಕು ವಿಧಗಳಿವೆ: ವೋಲ್ಟೇಜ್-ಸರಣಿ, ವೋಲ್ಟೇಜ್-ಸಮಾಂತರ, ಪ್ರವಾಹ-ಸರಣಿ ಮತ್ತು ಪ್ರವಾಹ-ಸಮಾಂತರ. ಔಟ್‌ಪುಟ್ ಮಾದರಿ ಮತ್ತು ಇನ್‌ಪುಟ್ ಮಿಶ್ರಣದಿಂದ ಹೆಸರು ಬರುತ್ತದೆ.

narration.en: On the board: four feedback topologies.

say.en: Each topology is named by what is sampled at the output and how it is mixed at the input.
Put it in a table. Voltage-series raises Zin and lowers Zout: an ideal voltage amplifier.

title.en: Effect on input and output impedance

body.en: Series mixing raises the input impedance, $Z_{if} = Z_i(1 + A\beta)$; shunt mixing lowers it, $Z_{if} = Z_i/(1 + A\beta)$. Voltage sampling lowers the output impedance, $Z_{of} = Z_o/(1 + A\beta)$, because the circuit tries to hold the output voltage constant; current sampling raises it, $Z_{of} = Z_o(1 + A\beta)$. So voltage-series feedback gives high input and low output impedance, the ideal voltage amplifier.

narration.en: Series mixing raises input impedance and shunt mixing lowers it. Voltage sampling lowers output impedance and current sampling raises it.
narration.kn: ಸರಣಿ ಮಿಶ್ರಣ ಇನ್‌ಪುಟ್ ಪ್ರತಿರೋಧವನ್ನು ಹೆಚ್ಚಿಸುತ್ತದೆ, ಸಮಾಂತರ ಮಿಶ್ರಣ ಕಡಿಮೆ ಮಾಡುತ್ತದೆ. ವೋಲ್ಟೇಜ್ ಮಾದರಿ ಔಟ್‌ಪುಟ್ ಪ್ರತಿರೋಧವನ್ನು ಕಡಿಮೆ ಮಾಡುತ್ತದೆ, ಪ್ರವಾಹ ಮಾದರಿ ಹೆಚ್ಚಿಸುತ್ತದೆ.

problem.en: An amplifier has A = 1000, Zi = 2 kΩ and Zo = 5.5 kΩ. Voltage-series feedback with β = 0.01 is applied. Find Af, Zif and Zof.

narration.en: Let us work this out together. An amplifier has A = 1000, Zi = 2 kΩ and Zo = 5.5 kΩ. Voltage-series feedback with β = 0.01 is applied. Find Af, Zif and Zof.

problem.en: Identify the type of feedback in a CE amplifier whose emitter resistor RE is not bypassed.

steps.en: The voltage across RE is ie × RE: it is proportional to the output (collector) current, so the output current is sampled.
This voltage appears in series with the base-emitter input loop, so the mixing is series.
Hence it is current-series feedback: the input impedance rises and the gain falls.

narration.en: Recap. Four types: voltage-series, voltage-shunt, current-series, current-shunt. Series mixing raises Zin; shunt mixing lowers it. Voltage sampling lowers Zout; current sampling raises it. Unbypassed RE gives current-series feedback.
